specification_compliance: Step 2: _source_kind (summaries.py:177-183) returns 'text' only for 'document' and 'transcript' for every other value including None; both builders take context_type=None and pass source_kind (summaries.py:186-224).

Step 3: all three templates compute is_text from source_kind | default("transcript"); _common_rules rendered with no variables yields the transcript branch, and the Environment uses StrictUndefined, but default() handles undefined, so test_common_rules_matches_golden remains valid.

Step 4/I1: the transcript branches reproduce the old text verbatim; the {% if %}/{% endif %} tags are placed inline with no whitespace control and trim_blocks is off (prompt_loader.py:18-23), so no newline is added or removed in the transcript branch.

Step 5: the text branch replaces '## Handling proper nouns' through the last 'Handle with care' bullet (_common_rules.jinja2:9-27), drops the culinary/ASR bullet as a whole line (lines 46-47), and replaces the short/long and detailed name bullets and the narrator->author spans in detailed_system.jinja2:40,45-47,51, keeping 'the author calls it'.

I6: both worker call sites pass context_type: generate_detailed_summary (summaries.py:1088) and _generate_short_long (summaries.py:1163); the on-index path (1411-1426) routes through both, so every production path gets the context-type-specific prompt; one LLM call per variant is unchanged.
regression_risks: If a future caller of _build_system_prompt/_build_detailed_system_prompt forgets to pass context_type, documents silently fall back to the transcript prompt (the safe side by design); only the two worker call sites and the PoC script exist today.

The goldens were added in the same submodule commit as the template edits; their 'captured before editing' provenance cannot be verified from the tree alone, though their content matches the transcript branch text exactly.
test_coverage: I1: test_prompt_loader.py:146-159 compares no-arg, None, video, audio, text and image against the goldens for ja/en/auto/fr for both builders; test_common_rules_matches_golden covers the bare include.
I7: test_prompt_loader.py:162-171 compares the document prompt to text_variant(golden), which asserts that each substituted span is unique and that the proper-noun span ends on a blank line.
I2-I5: substring tests at test_prompt_loader.py:174-240, each also asserting the transcript-side presence, so a mutant that always renders one branch is killed.

I6: test_summaries.py TestSystemPromptBySourceKind covers the on-index job and generate_detailed_summary for mp4, m4a, .loft (file_type 'other' + LOFT MIME), epub, pdf and markdown ('text'), and asserts assert_called_once plus the full system prompt. A mutant that drops context_type at either call site fails the document cases.
Mutant _source_kind returning 'text' for 'text' raw type: killed by the I1 'text' parameter, because the builders receive context types, not raw types.
